description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference across four different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right as "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU", with no apparent sorting applied. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "% point difference," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from -0.2 to 0.2 with a numeric tick label interval of 0.1, though the 0.1 label itself is visually obscured by a small grey rectangle. A solid horizontal line establishes the 0.0 baseline, accompanied by horizontal grid lines at each 0.1 increment. The chart utilizes grouped bars, where each category pairs two adjacent bars outlined in black. Based on the legend in the upper right, light blue bars represent "mBERT" and dark blue bars represent "XLM-R". In the "hidden:[50], linear" group, mBERT shows a value of approximately -0.20, while XLM-R is about -0.06. The "hidden:[], linear" group contains the only entirely positive values, with mBERT at roughly 0.09 and XLM-R forming the tallest bar overall at approximately 0.21. For "hidden:[100], ReLU", mBERT is negative at near -0.11, and XLM-R is slightly positive at about 0.02. Finally, the "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" category shows negative values for both, with mBERT at approximately -0.18 and XLM-R at roughly -0.14.
